question: What universal range must be encompassed when meditating on that object in every place?
premises: One should meditate in place after place.
The object of meditation is that one.
Its range extends from Śiva down to Avīci.
inference: The meditator should contemplate that object in every place as pervading all levels from Śiva to Avīci.
plain_english: Having meditated on him in place after place, as extending from Śiva down to Avīci.
